title: The canonical single-stranded DNA binding protein SSB is not an essential replication protein but an RNA chaperon in the hyperthermophilic archaeon Saccharolobus islandicus REY15A
authors: Yuanxi Xiao; Zhichao Jiang; Mengqi Zhang; Xuemei Zhang; Qi Gan; Yunfeng Yang; Pengju Wu; Xu Feng; Jinfeng Ni; Xiuzhu Dong; Qunxin She; Qihong Huang; Yulong Shen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究古菌SSB蛋白的RNA伴侣功能，虽涉及单链DNA结合蛋白，但核心是RNA代谢而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: Single-stranded DNA binding proteins (SSBs) have been regarded as indispensable factors in all three domains of life since they play vital roles in DNA replication. Herein, we report that genes coding for the canonical SSB (SisSSB) and the non-canonical SSB (SisDBP) in the hyperthermophilic archaeon Saccharolobus islandicus REY15A can both be deleted. The growth is not affected, and the cell cycle progression and genome stability of the deletion strains is not impaired, suggesting that SisSSB and SisDBP are not essential for cell viability. Interestingly, at a lower temperature (55°C), the protein level of SisSSB increases ∼1.8 fold in the wild type and the growth of Δ Sisssb and Δ Sisssb Δ Sisdbp is retarded. SisSSB exhibits melting activity on dsRNA and DNA/RNA hybrid in vitro and unwinding RNA hairpin in Escherichia coli . Furthermore, the core SisSSB domain is able to complement the absence of the cold shock proteins CspABGE in E. coli , suggesting that SisSSB functions as RNA chaperon. We show that a two-fold overexpression of SisSSB is beneficial to the cell growth at lower temperature, but it has detrimental effect on the cell growth and cell cycle progression at normal growth temperature, which differs from bacterial Csp proteins. Importantly, these in vitro and in vivo activities are conserved in SSB subtype SSB-1 in Crenarchaeota species that lack bacterial Csp homologs. Overall, we have clarified the function of the archaeal canonical SSB which does not function as a DNA processing factor, but plays a role in processes requiring dsRNA or DNA/RNA hybrid unwinding.
abstract_zh: 单链DNA结合蛋白（SSBs）在生命三个域中均被视为不可或缺的因子，因为它们在DNA复制中发挥关键作用。在此，我们报道，在超嗜热古菌 *Saccharolobus islandicus* REY15A 中，编码典型SSB（SisSSB）和非典型SSB（SisDBP）的基因均可被删除。生长不受影响，且缺失株的细胞周期进程和基因组稳定性未受损，表明SisSSB和SisDBP并非细胞生存所必需。有趣的是，在较低温度（55°C）下，野生型中SisSSB的蛋白水平增加约1.8倍，且Δ *Sisssb* 和Δ *Sisssb* Δ *Sisdbp* 的生长受到延缓。SisSSB在体外对双链RNA和DNA/RNA杂交体表现出解链活性，并在 *Escherichia coli* 中解开RNA发夹结构。此外，核心SisSSB结构域能够互补 *E. coli* 中冷休克蛋白CspABGE的缺失，表明SisSSB作为RNA伴侣蛋白发挥作用。我们显示，SisSSB的过表达两倍在较低温度下有利于细胞生长，但在正常生长温度下对细胞生长和细胞周期进程产生不利影响，这与细菌Csp蛋白不同。重要的是，这些体外和体内活性在泉古菌门（Crenarchaeota）物种中缺乏细菌Csp同源物的SSB亚型SSB-1中保守。总体而言，我们阐明了古菌典型SSB的功能，它不作为DNA加工因子，而是在需要双链RNA或DNA/RNA杂交体解链的过程中发挥作用。
